newsitem.title: USA: Ethical wait period for Searle deal ends.
newsitem.headline: Ethical wait period for Searle deal ends.

text.p: Ethical Holdings Plc Thursday said it received clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust act for its alliance with G.D. Searle & Co, a pharmaceutical subsidiary of Monsanto Co.
The pact was signed in December 1996 and following the clearance, Ethical said it received an unspecified "significant" upfront payment from Searle.

Ethical's alliance with Searle covers the development and marketing in the United States and selected international markets of a range of Ethical's transdermal patches for use in Hormone Replacement Therapy.
Earlier this month, Searle extended their rights to Ethical's HRT products to include Canada.

Since the signing of this alliance, Ethical said it has made progress on HRT product development programs in the U.S. Phase III clinical trials on the seven-day oestradiol patch are ongoing and preparation is now in advanced stages to enter directly into low stage clinical trials in the U.S. for the HRT combination patches for use in both continuous and sequential therapy.
Ethical is a global pharmaceutical group which develops pharmaceutical products across a range of therapeutic areas utilizing its proprietary advanced oral and transdermal drug delivery technologies.
Searle, based in Skokie, Ill., develops, manufactures and markets pharmaceuticals and other health care solutions worldwide.
